description: This file contains unit tests for the web pa interface and related components using GoogleTest framework. It tests component discovery, message sending, component health status checks, Ethernet/WAN status, and device MAC retrieval, including mocking dependencies and global variables.

methods.name: Cosa_FindDestComp
methods.description: Discovers component details given an object name.

methods.name: sendWebpaMsg
methods.description: Sends a WebPA message with specified parameters.

methods.name: rdk_logger_module_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the logger module name used for logging.

methods.name: checkComponentHealthStatus
methods.description: Checks the health status of a specified component.

methods.name: waitForEthAgentComponentReady
methods.description: Waits until Ethernet agent component is ready by checking health status repeatedly.

methods.name: check_ethernet_wan_status
methods.description: Checks the status of Ethernet WAN, using syscfg and component discovery.

methods.name: getDeviceMac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device from sysevent.
